records.claim: There is 1 report of a man who had delayed ejaculation and impotence (trouble with getting and keeping an erection) while taking alprazolam. One small study found lower sperm motility (movement) in those taking psychotropic medications (including alprazolam) compared to men who did not take psychotropic medication. These issues might make it harder to conceive a pregnancy. In general, exposures that men or sperm donors have are less likely to increase risks to a pregnancy. For more general information, please see the MotherToBaby fact sheet Paternal Exposures at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/paternal-exposures-pregnancy/
records.source_section: If a man takes alprazolam, could it affect his fertility or increase the chance of birth defects?
